[](/TinkeringDao/CiMind/blob/main/LICENSE) Localfirst, zerocloud, auditable cognitive prosthetic and ambientsafety kernel for dementia and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) assistiveliving research across Reisberg functional stages (GDS 1–7). CiMind (TinkeringDao Labs — [tinkeringdao.dev/research/cimind/](https://tinkeringdao.dev/research/cimind/)) treats any local language model strictly as an untrusted reasoning coprocessor behind deterministic Python verification seams. Lifesafety reflexes, epistemic memory boundaries, stageadaptive dialogue rules, commerce velocity caps, and longitudinal observational baselines execute in pure, offlineverifiable Python (3.11+ standard library only; zero thirdparty runtime dependencies) backed by an appendonly SHA256 hashchained SQLite audit ledger. For full primarysource clinical and engineering citations (PMID, NCT, CIE S 026, arXiv) and the v0.2.0 kernelvsadapter boundary matrix, see [docs/CLINICAL\_AND\_SYSTEMS\_EVIDENCE\_RATIONALE.md](/TinkeringDao/CiMind/blob/main/docs/CLINICAL%5FAND%5FSYSTEMS%5FEVIDENCE%5FRATIONALE.md). Core Design Invariants AssistiveCare Failure Mode Deterministic CiMind Guardrail Module Confabulated medication claims, TV dialogue bleed, or phantom sensor assumptions Four isolated epistemic zones (ClinicalVault, VerifiedBiography, SensorEpisodeBank, PatientUtteranceQuarantine), 4gate VAD/SNR/nearfield broadcast filter, and explicit UnobservedModalitiesHeader [src/cimind/mmu.py](/TinkeringDao/CiMind/blob/main/src/cimind/mmu.py) NPU/LLM inference stalls on fall detection, nighttime wandering, or perimeter locks Pure < 5 ms, zeroI/O reducer evaluating camerafree 2of3 floor fusion (60 GHz mmWave \+ 32x24 thermal + 15 cm dToF/piezo), 590 nm bedexit strip, 0V failsafe geolock cutouts, and 4state BLE/UWB LoRaWAN GNSS handover [src/cimind/reflex.py](/TinkeringDao/CiMind/blob/main/src/cimind/reflex.py) Realityorientation quizzes, bereavement retraumatization, L2 attrition, or impulsive purchases Stagegoverned TherapeuticMode (PeerCoPilot \ GuidedConcierge \ 3step IntegrativeValidation \ dysphagiasafe SensoryPalliative), intraturn L2 L1 mothertongue pivot, \= 40% Ikigai rolereversal quota, seated GDS <= 3 Cognicise, and velocitycapped 3card CoAgency Concierge [src/cimind/companion.py](/TinkeringDao/CiMind/blob/main/src/c

BLADE // BLEED KINETIC // SHRED ENERGY // PLASMA SYNCING ARMORY FEED… TACTICAL KNOWLEDGE BASE Master the Arena Before Your First Duel [RU Version →](/ru/) [ 4Zone Combat & Classes Assault vs Saboteur vs Liquidator countertriangle, stats, and chip caps. ](/guides/combatsystem/) [ Clan Wars & Sector Sieges How 9sector influence, 15m telegraphs, garrisons, and Heist raids work. ](/guides/clanwars/) [ Browser PvP RPG Overview Why SYNDICATE is built for instant zeroinstall tactical PvP without P2W. ](/guides/browserpvprpg/) FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Everything You Need to Know Is SYNDICATE: Tactical Arena free to play? expand\_more Yes. SYNDICATE is 100% free to play directly in your desktop or mobile browser with zero installation, and also available free on Android via Google Play. Is SYNDICATE PaytoWin? expand\_more No. Every weapon, armor set, Tier3 neural chip, and companion is earnable through PvP, PvE, and CyberForge crafting. Paid Armory Skins are strictly cosmetic with zero combat stats. How does the 4zone turnbased combat system work? expand\_more Each round, both fighters simultaneously choose an Attack Zone and Defense Zones (Head, Chest, Belt, Legs) plus tactical skills. The authoritative server resolves initiative, evasion, critical hits, armor, and chip procs deterministically. Can I play with the same account on PC browser and Android? expand\_more Yes. Full crossplay and shared progression are supported via Google, Email, or Telegram signin across desktop web, mobile web, and the Android app. How long does a PvP match or tournament take? expand\_more A 1v1 duel lasts 1.5 to 3 minutes. 4man Sprint Cups launch with a 90second cadence and automatic backfill so you never wait in empty lobbies, plus a daily 16man Grand Prix at 19:00 UTC. What are the classes and build archetypes? expand\_more Operatives specialize via STR, AGI, INT, and END into three archetypes: Assault (heavy armor & raw damage), Saboteur (high evasion & counterattacks), and Liquidator (precision critical strikes that counter dodge). How do Clan Wars and 9Sector Sieges work? expand\_more Syndicates of up to 30 operatives battle over 9 city districts. Holding sectors pays daily CR tribute and grants crafting discounts. Enemy districts flip only via primetime sieges with 15minute telegraphs and precommitted defensive garrisons. Does SYNDICATE have PvE content besides PvP? expand\_more Yes. Play the 27mission Underworld Ops campaign across 3 acts, explore multitier Catacombs dungeons, hunt Weekly WANTED bosses, or team up in 48hour Syndicate Heist clan raids. items.title: Show HN: Weekly playlists of random songs from the streaming catalogues
items.desc: description: Free ourselves from curated content title: Randibri image: https://randibri.com/wpcontent/uploads/2026/11/SocialMediaVorschauscaled.jpg [Skip to content](wpskiplinktarget) no algorithm · no curation · no repeats Eleven playlists, picked by pure chance. Every week we draw songs at random from well over a hundred million recordings, from forgotten Bsides to yesterday’s releases: one list of pure chance, one for every decade since the 1950s, and two that mix the decades, the same on TIDAL, Spotify and YouTube Music. Nobody chooses them. Not us, and not a recommendation engine. [This week’s draw](weeks) [How the draw works](https://randibri.com/methodology/) Random Music, week by week November 22, 2026 [Randibri 2](https://randibri.com/2026/11/22/randibri2/) Eleven playlists drawn at random in the week of 20261116, with the same songs on TIDAL, Spotify and YouTube Music. Nobody picked them, and no song from an earlier week comes back. How the draw works is explained on the [Methodology page](/methodology/). 77 songs True Random ?77 songs drawn from everything, every song with the same chance. About two thirds of the listenable music on the streaming services was recorded in the 2020s and a fifth in the 2010s, so chance gives this list about the same mix. [See the decades chart →](rbchart) The plain draw from everything. [](https://listen.tidal.com/playlist/df4f43edb7c14b2ea670b02f4b63a921 "TIDAL")[](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/5jglRhecbr4cSZHUTdcvwd "Spotify")[](https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKB0CVz3mDVc "YouTube Music")[Apple Music?](rbapple "Apple Music is not part of Randibri yet") Claude’s takeThis week's True Random hands the Rotbachtal alphorn group the Magic of Music and lets it echo into 1956, where André Claveau begs his darling to stay faithful. A Supreme Colonel crashes a private party in the Sierra de Durango, a 2014 remix trims Mustache and Beard, and a voice message from Hélio & Junior arrives. Open it? 88 songs Equal Decades ?Every decade gets eleven songs. These are drawn at random from the decade lists below. The first decade, the 1950s, also takes in everything recorded earlier. [See the decades chart →](rbchart) Eleven songs from every decade, from the 1950s (and before) to the 2020s. [](https://listen.tidal.com/playlist/4f588963419049a8bf469e59c98d47f0 "TIDAL")[](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7c47vnUWoajRMW50bx92Le "Spotify")[](https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDnNn%5FEjbdVo "YouTube Music") Claude’s takeThis week's Equal Decades has no brakes. In 1931 John Charles Thomas is Smilin' Through, Jerry Lee Lewis lights Great Balls of Fire in 1957, and Josipa Lisac tells someone You Are a Genius in 1979\. Patti Kim calls for Fernando, the Papanui Maori Ensemble arrives from 1999, and by 2006 somebody's got Wet Pants. Who, and why? 88 songs Squared Decades ?The more music a decade has, the more songs it gets, but not in proportion to its size: in proportion to its square root. So the crowded recent decades get more room without drowning out the rare old ones. Drawn at random from the decade lists below. [See the decades chart →](rbchart) Decades with more music get more room, but not all of it. [](https://listen.tidal.com/playlist/00cf1a8b10c346a3b21b01ba4d022fe0 "TIDAL")[](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6JYE1Fm6j1JRC5OuUbd9gv "Spotify")[](https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLL72J%5Ff337hU "YouTube Music") Claude’s takeThis week's Squared Decades asks Who's Who Are You? in 1928 and never gets a straight answer. Kazuko Yasukawa replies with a Riddle in 1994, Puccini sends three cops and a carriage, and the Grateful Dead ride to El Paso via Austin, 1971\. Then Manic Street Preachers name four banks. Which one gets robbed? [The eight decade lists and this week’s random number →](https://randibri.com/?p=190decades) The decade lists ?Each decade has its own draw of 33 songs, sorted by the year the song was recorded; everything before 1950 counts as the 1950s. Old songs are rare, so an old decade is sometimes filled with the help of a [narrow band search](/methodology/narrowband). [See the decades chart →](rbchart) 33 songs for every decade, by the year the song was recorded. The 1950s list also holds everything older. Decade Songs Listen 1950s and earlierClaude’s takeThis week's 1950s and earlier is a runaway time machine. In 1956 André Claveau begs "Darling, be faithful," Concha Piquer swears to stay "by your side," and in 1928 Paul Ash demands "Who's Who Are You?" The Coasters reply "Yakety Yak," Jerry Lee Lewis hurls Great Balls of Fire, and the Bolshoi wants to dream. Someone still owes Paul an answer. 33[7 from the narrow band search](/methodology/narrowband) [](https://listen.tidal.com/playlist/f2bb2ace57be4301b69bb9024e227003 "TIDAL")[](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6ehBiWg8YUdC2yUFC9YXCK "Spotify")[](https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLT3UwhUD1gs8 "YouTube Music") 1960sClaude’s takeThis week's 1960s sails from Rudi Horn's "Foreign Shores, Foreign Stars" to the Greenland Whale Fisheries, while Barbara polishes "Golden Buttons." Trini Lopez confesses "I Have Nothing," Los Iracundos only show up "Sometimes on Fridays," and Frank Zappa's Mothers of Invention insist I Ain't Got No Heart. And Doris Day? She wants your hands. 33[10 from the narrow band search](/methodology/narrowband) [](https://listen.tidal.com/playlist/f207c0a71d9744e6afa33c7b0d859b4e "TIDAL")[](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3ka9wAmjD9goq1m40NCzQK "Spotify")[](https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOW7nMPhdg3o "YouTube Music") 1970sClaude’s takeThis week's 1970s is a road trip without a map. Nanni Svampa lets "The Gorilla" loose in Italy, Josipa Lisac declares "You're a Genius," and Christophe scribbles "the blue words." Charley Pride can only see as far as you, the Grateful Dead roll into El Paso live in Austin, and Raffaella Carrà calls for Maria. Somebody, please, follow that gorilla. 33 [](https://listen.tidal.com/playlist/b280738add8b43389de44

items.title: Show HN: Delete windows/Linux directories with Filters and Exclusions
items.desc: description: FilteredDelete is a .NET 10 desktop utility for selective folder cleanup. Review deletion previews, preserve important files, use recursive wildcard exclusions, and move approved items to the Windows Recycle Bin or Linux Trash. title: FilteredDelete — Selective Folder Cleanup for Windows and Linux Algolassi image: https://algolassi.online/assets/images/algolassisocialcard.png [🏠 Home ▼ ](/) [📚 Tutorials ](/tutorials/) [ℹ️ About ](/aboutalgolassi/) / 📄 FilteredDelete — Selective Folder Cleanup for Windows and Linux [← All AlgoLassi products](/products/) FilteredDelete downloads Latest release downloads [ ](https://github.com/greatPHPer/FilteredDelete%5Frelease/releases/latest) The latest public release, v1.0.1, is available now with Windows x64, Linux x64, and Linux ARM64 packages plus SHA256 checksums. It includes the clearer checked = delete / unchecked = keep selection behavior. The download counter above tracks this latest release only; older release downloads are not mixed into the displayed count. [View official downloads on GitHub ↗](https://github.com/greatPHPer/FilteredDelete%5Frelease/releases) [Release repository ↗](https://github.com/greatPHPer/FilteredDelete%5Frelease) Version v1.0.1 passed all 51 local automated tests and a successful Release build. Its Windows x64, Linux x64, and Linux ARM64 packages and SHA256 checksums are now published. Linux desktop behaviour should still be checked on native Linux systems and desktop environments. Selective cleanup, not blind deletion FilteredDelete is designed for project folders containing build output, caches, temporary files, and other items that are often safe to remove—but where a blanket delete command can easily remove something important. 01 Browse a folder tree Explore folders and files in a readable tree. Deletable items start checked; uncheck individual files or folders you want to retain. 02 Use recursive exclusions Apply foldername wildcard patterns such as bin, obj, or cache, with configurable branch scope and search depth. 03 Generate a deletion preview Review proposed toplevel operations, preserved items, counts, estimated size, and any entries that need attention before execution. 04 Move to system Trash Use the Windows Recycle Bin or Linux FreeDesktop Trash as the default deletion path. A failed Trash operation is reported rather than silently becoming permanent deletion. 05 Copy or move selected items Copy To and Move To support manually kept (unchecked) files and folders, avoid overwriting existing destination items, and reject unsafe source/destination relationships. 06 Keep permanent deletion separate Permanent deletion is an advanced, separate action. It requires typing DELETE before it can proceed. The selection rule is simple All deletable files and folders start checked. Check means delete; uncheck means keep. The selected root folder is always kept. Tree state Meaning ☑ Checked Selected for deletion, subject to the generated preview and safety checks. ☐ Unchecked Keep this file or folder and its contents. ▣ Indeterminate The folder contains a mixture of items to delete and items to keep. A parent directory can be retained as a container when it has a protected child. The selected root directory is retained too. A checked directory is eligible for removal, not guaranteed to be removed in every plan. Safety checks are part of execution The approved preview is rebuilt and compared with the current filesystem state before execution. Inaccessible paths, incomplete scans, and unsafe links or reparse points can block execution or require review. Preserved descendants keep the ancestor directories needed to contain them. Trash failures are reported; the application does not silently fall back to permanent deletion. Permanent deletion remains separate and requires an explicit confirmation. These safeguards reduce accidental cleanup risk, but filesystem APIs cannot lock an entire directory tree against every concurrent change. Keep backups of important data, particularly before using permanent deletion. Build targets Platform Architecture Planned archive Windows x64 ZIP Linux x64 tar.gz Linux ARM64 tar.gz These are selfcontained .NET 10 builds. Linux systems still need the graphics and input libraries required by Avalonia and their desktop environment. Get FilteredDelete Get the latest versioned downloads, release notes, and SHA256 checksums from the public release page.
